events.verdict: Green (CHA) moves laterally into Hunter's (ATL) space and body contact occurs, which affects his layup attempt in the paint.
Richards (CHA) establishes himself in Johnson's (ATL) path and then turns to roll towards the basket and marginal contact occurs as he and Johnson come together.
Okongwu (ATL) legally contests Micic's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Green (CHA) briefly rests his hand on Young's (ATL) shoulder as the pick is set and the marginal contact quickly dissolves as both players maneuver around the pick.
Johnson (ATL) firms up in Green's (CHA) path and does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the pick.
Hunter (ATL) firms up in Green's (CHA) path and marginal contact occurs as Green moves into the pick.
Richards (CHA) extends his forearm across Hunter's (ATL) front, and he initiates contact that affects Hunter's SQBR as he gathers the ball in the paint.
Diabaté (CHA) and Okongwu (ATL) engage and disengage with one another on the rebound.
Hunter (ATL) steps to his right and marginal contact occurs briefly with Miller (CHA) as the two players come together off-ball.
Miller (CHA) establishes himself in Johnson's (ATL) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together after Miller sets the pick and attempts to slip towards the perimeter.
Daniels (ATL) brings his arm down towards the ball and marginal brush contact occurs with Miller (CHA) during the driving shot attempt in the paint.
Diabaté (CHA) legally touches the ball as it is rolling off of the rim.

Okongwu (ATL) brings his left hand down as he goes into the air to contest Miller's (CHA) driving shot attempt and his left hand briefly brushes Miller's right arm. The brush contact during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
Johnson (ATL) turns to begin his run towards the frontcourt and marginal contact occurs as he comes together with Green (CHA).
Hunter (ATL) swiftly rests and removes his hands from Martin's (CHA) sides as he releases away from the defender after setting the pick and the contact is marginal.
Hunter (ATL) gathers the ball on his left foot and takes one legal step before releasing his shot attempt.
Diabaté (CHA) turns to come alongside Hunter (ATL) and marginal lower body contact occurs as the two players come together during the layup attempt in the paint.
Green's (CHA) hand comes forward slightly and his hand grazes Hunter's (ATL) arm during his layup attempt in the paint. The brush contact on the play is marginal.
Johnson (ATL) reaches in for the ball and makes contact with Micic's (CHA) right arm, which affects the release of his pass.
Diabaté (CHA) raises his arm up and makes contact with the ball, which deflects it away, prior to incidental arm contact occurring with Okongwu (ATL).
Miller's (CHA) arms come out slightly as he releases away from the defender during the inbound and the contact is marginal.
Miller (CHA) slides his pivot foot forward prior to releasing the ball to start his dribble.

Replay review of the defensive non-shooting foul called on Hunter (ATL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Hunter's hand come forward slightly and lightly brushes Miller's (CHA) right arm. The contact is marginal and does not affect Miller's SQBR prior to him gathering the ball. Charlotte is in possession of the ball at the time of the foul and is awarded possession when play resumes. The resumption of play rule is properly adjudicated.
Miller's (CHA) left arm comes out slightly as he releases away form the defender and the contact during the inbound is considered marginal.
Daniels (ATL) legally contests Miller's  (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Miller (CHA) commits a take foul on Hunter (ATL). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Daniels (ATL) legally contests Miller's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Diabaté (CHA) commits a take foul on Okongwu (ATL).

Young (ATL) raises his arm up towards the ball and he avoids making any illegal contact with Micic (CHA) during Micic's driving shot attempt. Replay review confirms the ball is released prior to the game clock expiring.
